ov: A shaggy bear of the Indian subcontinent with a mane around its face, a long lower lip and long, sickle-shaped claws. It feeds on termites, ants and fruit, blowing away soil and sucking the insects up through its muzzle.

why.dg: One of the most aggressive bears, and attacks are fairly frequent where people live close to it.
why.ac: It forages at night and returns to its den around dawn.

df: Termites, ants and bees, plus fruit such as mangoes and jackfruit, mahua flowers, honey and carrion.
fx: It finds termite mounds and bee nests by smell, and can sniff out grubs 3 ft below ground.
It has the longest tail of any bear, up to 15–18 cm.
